title: Penalty not awarded: handball appeal against Mazraoui
summary: Penalty not awarded: Handball appeal against Mazraoui. Panel: The Referee's call of no penalty for a potential handball offence against Mazraoui was supported. The ball was struck from close proximity with the defender's arms in an expected position given his blocking action.
